## bijection_verdict

**PASS.**

Policy-side notes (do not change the verdict):
- P1: `folio_evt_adjustment` lists `elite_benefit_not_applied` only for exempt late check-out fees and `incorrect_rate` only for room lines; the extended parking policies use the first for parking savings and record the election with "the stay's parking was charged above the applicable rate" (tool code incorrect_rate) without a declared overwrite of the reason schedule. The KB renders both sides faithfully; a reader resolves it by the specific documents.
- P2: "Each original line is adjusted at most once" (base) can collide with the extended rules when the seventh night parked is also the most recent valet (or self-parking) line, e.g. a stay of exactly seven nights parked; no overwrite declares which wins. Not triggered in this task (three distinct lines).
- P3: the superseded parking clause and its replacements state the same per-night posting at brand rates; the retirement is semantically a re-statement (same pattern as task 0 N1).

Previous revisions: none (revision 1).
